climate-security-2021-12-13.national-russia-explanation: Russia opposed a generic climate-security link, preferring substantive work at the UNFCCC and a Sahel-specific draft addressing that region's unique insecurities.
climate-security-2021-12-13.national-india-explanation: India opposed shifting climate decisions from the universal, consensus-based UNFCCC to the Security Council because most developing countries lack a voice there, and it supported a draft limited to the Sahel region.
